HYP-MOM.research_question: Does momentum return information show horizon-dependent predictive association?
HYP-MOM.mechanism: Price trends propagate through investor underreaction over multiple sessions
HYP-MOM.predicted_direction: Positive IC at H-10/H-20 exceeding H-5
HYP-MOM.falsification: If IC at H-10/H-20 does not exceed H-5 IC, horizon-mismatch is not supported for momentum
HYP-MOM.relationship_to_prior: Extends Phase 9-13 OHLCV research to multiple horizons

HYP-VOL.research_question: Does volatility information show horizon-dependent predictive association?
HYP-VOL.mechanism: Volatility regimes persist over multi-session periods
HYP-VOL.predicted_direction: Positive IC at H-10/H-20, potentially negative at H-5
HYP-VOL.falsification: If volatility IC does not vary systematically across horizons, mechanism is not supported
HYP-VOL.relationship_to_prior: Extends Phase 14.5 volatility dynamics (H-4 FRAGILE) to explicit horizon test

HYP-MAC.research_question: Does macro regime information show stronger predictive association at longer horizons?
HYP-MAC.mechanism: Macro conditions influence corporate earnings and discount rates over weeks to months
HYP-MAC.predicted_direction: Positive IC at H-20 exceeding H-10 and H-5
HYP-MAC.falsification: If macro IC is stronger at H-5 than H-20, mechanism is not supported
HYP-MAC.relationship_to_prior: Extends H-3 macro regime (Phase 14.5/15/17A) to explicit horizon comparison

HYP-XSEC.research_question: Does cross-sectional relative strength show horizon-dependent predictive association?
HYP-XSEC.mechanism: Relative ranking captures mean-reversion and momentum across instruments
HYP-XSEC.falsification: If cross-sectional IC varies dramatically across horizons, it is not horizon-robust
limitations: SMA ratios are price-based, not true cross-sectional
